nextHour.rootCause: The observed provider_data_rejected_arrays header does not reveal which normalized array was empty. The source generator maps precipitation_2h to minutes, derives summary, then derives conditions. A valid dry sample is a complete zero/CLEAR timeline; an empty sequence is not evidence of dry weather. A confirmed generation path filtered FLURRIES/POSSIBLE_FLURRIES against a separate enum table before the strict WK3 converter, potentially leaving a valid snow summary/minutes with condition=[]; this experiment narrowly hands only those two symbolic snow conditions to the existing strict adapter. The exact cause of the reported Tangshan request remains unconfirmed until WK3NH/5 array states are read on-device.
nextHour.conversion: SNOW and SLEET summaries map only to their upstream-declared WK3 precipitation enums with strictly aligned positive minute evidence. SNOW/HEAVY_SNOW and SLEET/POSSIBLE_SLEET conditions are phase-bound to matching validated summaries. FLURRIES/POSSIBLE_FLURRIES have no guessed enum; only their whole descriptive vector may be omitted when a validated SNOW summary and minute evidence exist. Hail, mixed phase, unknown symbols, contradictions, incomplete values or bad timing fail open.
nextHour.diagnosticHeader: X-WK3-NextHour-Diag WK3NH/5; arrays=summary/condition/minutes states (missing, invalid, empty, nonempty); bounded counts and safe classification; excludes coordinates, tokens, raw values and response body.

This does not validate minute-by-minute ColorfulClouds agreement or forecast quantity accuracy; Stable Candidate still awaits a short device regression.
